import BusyBeaver.ZFC.EnumStackBarrier254

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.EnumStackBarrier254Audit
open Code254 Enum254 EnumStackBarrier254

example : unpack 0 = (.mp 0, 0) := rfl
example : unpack 1 = (.drop 0, 0) := rfl
example : unpack 3 = (.nip 0, 0) := rfl
example : EnumStackBarrier254.decode 0 = (.mp 0, []) := decode_zero

 theorem every_candidate (n : Nat) : ∃ c cs, encL c cs = n :=
  ⟨(EnumStackBarrier254.decode n).1, (EnumStackBarrier254.decode n).2, encL_decode n⟩

 theorem candidate_roundtrip (c : Cmd) (cs : List Cmd) :
    EnumStackBarrier254.decode (encL c cs) = (c, cs) := decode_encL c cs

 theorem actual_command (n np : Nat) (s : St) :
    execAt n np s =
      match cstep (unpack n).1 (toW s) with
      | none => none
      | some w => some ⟨(unpack n).2, np, w.tw, w.ws, w.d, w.h⟩ := execAt_unpack n np s

 theorem marked_earlier (pre suf : List Cmd) (x : Nat) :
    ∃ lo hi, listCode (pre ++ .nip x :: suf) = some hi ∧
      listCode (swapAt pre.length (pre ++ .nip x :: suf)) = some lo ∧ lo < hi :=
  marked_occurrence_lower pre suf x

 theorem marked_injective (cs ds : List Cmd) (i j : Nat)
    (h : (listCode (swapAt i cs), i) = (listCode (swapAt j ds), j)) :
    cs = ds ∧ i = j := occurrence_image_injective cs ds i j h

 theorem arbitrary_bottom (bottom : Nat) :
    C254 (unP (P 0 bottom)).1 ∧ SafeStack bottom 0 (unP (P 0 bottom)).2 :=
  safeStack_pop (by decide) (safeStack_cons C254.truth (safeStack_nil bottom))

 theorem actual_prefix_step (bottom credit : Nat) (s s' : St)
    (hs : PrefixInv bottom credit (toW s))
    (hp : PopAdmissible (unpack (fetch s).1).1 credit)
    (he : enumStep s = some s') :
    PrefixInv bottom (nextCredit (unpack (fetch s).1).1 credit) (toW s') :=
  enumStep_prefix hs hp he

 theorem actual_prefix_halt (bottom credit : Nat) (s : St)
    (hs : PrefixInv bottom credit (toW s)) (he : enumStep s = none) : C254 F :=
  enumStep_halt hs he

 theorem reset (t stack h : Nat) :
    ∃ out, enumStep ⟨0, 0, t, stack, 0, h⟩ = some out ∧
      out.pl = 0 ∧ out.np = 1 ∧ out.tw = 0 ∧ out.d = 0 ∧ out.h = 0 ∧
      PrefixInv stack 0 (toW out) := candidate_zero_reset t stack h
